name: hou_mcp_workflow_templates
description: Browse or apply workflow templates. With template_id empty and list_all=true, returns all template metadata. With template_id set and context_json provided, resolves the template to concrete operations (does NOT execute — wire to hou_mcp_transaction for execution).
python_code:
from src.nodes.base import BaseNode
import json

class Hou_Mcp_Workflow_Templates(BaseNode):
    name = "hou_mcp_workflow_templates"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("template_id",  "string", widget_type="text",     default="")
        self.add_input("context_json", "string", widget_type="text",     default="{}")
        self.add_input("list_all",     "bool",   widget_type="checkbox", default=True)
        self.add_input("tag_filter",   "string", widget_type="text",     default="")
        self.add_output("templates",    "list")
        self.add_output("template_ids", "list")
        self.add_output("operations",   "list")
        self.add_output("count",        "int")
        self.add_output("errors",       "list")
        self.add_output("report_json",  "string")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        from src.runtime.workflow_templates import get_workflow_templates
        tmpl_id    = str(inputs.get("template_id") or "").strip()
        ctx_raw    = inputs.get("context_json") or "{}"
        list_all   = bool(inputs.get("list_all", True))
        tag_filter = str(inputs.get("tag_filter") or "").strip() or None

        errors:    list = []
        operations: list = []
        wt = get_workflow_templates()

        # Parse context
        context = {}
        if tmpl_id:
            try:
                context = json.loads(ctx_raw) if isinstance(ctx_raw, str) else dict(ctx_raw or {})
            except Exception as exc:
                errors.append(f"context_json parse error: {exc}")

        # List templates
        templates = []
        if list_all or not tmpl_id:
            templates = wt.list_templates(tag=tag_filter)

        # Resolve specific template if requested
        if tmpl_id and not errors:
            try:
                operations = wt.apply_template(tmpl_id, context)
            except KeyError as exc:
                errors.append(str(exc))
            except Exception as exc:
                errors.append(f"Template apply error: {exc}")

        template_ids = [t["template_id"] for t in templates] if templates else ([tmpl_id] if tmpl_id else [])
        report = {"templates": templates, "template_ids": template_ids, "count": len(templates), "errors": errors}

        return {
            "exec_out":     True,
            "templates":    templates,
            "template_ids": template_ids,
            "operations":   operations,
            "count":        len(templates),
            "errors":       errors,
            "report_json":  json.dumps(report),
        }

def register_node():
    return Hou_Mcp_Workflow_Templates
